fact: Thabethe and Mathews state that all public health facilities in the Eastern Cape (727 primary health care clinics, 41 community health centres and 92 hospitals) use DHIS2 for routine reporting, that the monthly data are captured into DHIS2 by a trained information cadre in the health facility, and that sampled facilities submitted 9,489 of 9,540 expected monthly reports (99.5%) from April 2017 to March 2020.
title: Quality of routine health data in DHIS2 in South Africa: Eastern Cape province from 2017-2020
publisher: South African Journal of Information Management
